title: Oligo Analyzer Pro (v1.0.0, Bio-Tools Suite)

provenance.origin: github.com/rao-monika-yadav/oligo-analyzer at fb45bfb3a423, github (github: topic:streamlit topic:genomics archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Gives the Wallace-rule Tm, GC%, AT%, molecular weight, base composition and reverse complement for one pasted primer, or for every record in an uploaded FASTA/txt file, with a GC% vs Tm scatter plot and a CSV report. Data used in the run: synthetic. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
